summary.text: Adam Zabner is a Democratic state representative from Iowa House District 90 who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as organizer.

paragraphs.text: Adam Zabner was born in Iowa City, Iowa, and earned a B.S. in neuroscience from the University of Chicago in 2021.

His career experience includes working as an out-of-state volunteer coordinator with Jon Ossoff's 2020 U.S. Senate campaign, a regional organizing director with the Iowa Democratic Party, and a research assistant with the Marine Biological Laboratory and the University of Iowa.
Zabner defeated Andrew Dunn and Christine Wolfe in the June 7, 2022 Democratic primary for Iowa House District 90, succeeding Cindy Winckler, and won re-election on November 5, 2024.
For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia shows him assigned to the House Appropriations, House Commerce, House Local Government and House State Government committees.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary and is listed as the candidate in the general election.
